accuracy_floor_source: lowest delayed balanced accuracy of real replay months 1 to 4 (results/phase3/monthly/month_02.json to month_05.json)

rules.abstain_share: the share of the month's images whose OOD score is above the abstain threshold (the baseline's 95th percentile)
rules.accuracy_floor: delayed balanced accuracy below the lowest in-distribution month is a drop
rules.alert_rule: alert when KS p < 0.01 and PSI >= 0.2; warning when PSI >= 0.1 without an alert
rules.labels: a month's accuracy is reported by the next month's run; when the key is missing, labels have not arrived
rules.live_check: new public images are counted each month, not downloaded or scored
rules.month_alert: the month is in alert when the overall test or any skin-type test alerts
rules.report_when: an 8D report only when the month is in alert; for a warning or no drift, findings only and no 8D report
rules.skin_type_caveat: skin type is recorded only at the new sites, so a skin-type alert detects the site, not anything about skin type
rules.skin_type_rule: the same test per Fitzpatrick type with at least 100 images that month; smaller or unrecorded groups get counts only and never alert
